diagnostics.message: :module.csi: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.csi declares `depends_on = [module.eks]`, but its `eks-addons` inputs already reference `module.eks.cluster.name` and `module.eks.oidc`, which creates an implicit dependency on module.eks. The explicit `depends_on` is therefore redundant and can be removed.
